stage: Stage 11 CausalOnly-CMI normalized split conformal prediction

cmi.estimator_provenance: Tigramite CMIknn; k=20; 99 surrogates; conditioned on s_x,s_y; scale_fit labels only
cmi.normalization: w_j = raw_cmi_j / sum(raw_cmi over eligible features)

distance.causal: sqrt(sum_j w_j * (z_aj-z_bj)^2) over eligible causal attributes only

scale_estimator.aggregation: unweighted mean over k nearest neighbors
scale_estimator.tie_rule: largest k among MAEs equal within 1e-12
scale_estimator.no_signal_fallback: sigma_global = mean scale_fit absolute residual, constant downstream

label_access_order: scale_fit: residual reference and feature standardization
final_calibration: conformal quantile only after weights and k are frozen
test: evaluation only after the conformal quantile is frozen
material_undercoverage: mean coverage < 0.89 or more than 0.01 below Raw-CP
paired_ci: two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval for the mean paired replicate difference
